description: This file provides utility functions and classes for handling ASN.1 object differences, including algorithms for adding, removing, and modifying ASN.1 objects in lists based on their IDs. It includes comparison functors, diff calculation functions, and setup/release ASN.1 object management, primarily used during reconfiguration processes in a 3GPP-related context.

classes.name: obj_id_comparator
classes.description: A functor that compares objects based on their IDs using a provided ID extraction function.

methods.name: make_id_comparator
methods.description: Creates an obj_id_comparator functor for comparing objects based on their IDs.

methods.name: apply_addmodremlist_diff
methods.description: Applies differences to add/modify and remove ASN.1 objects in a list based on previous and diff lists.

methods.name: calculate_addmodremlist_diff
methods.description: Calculates the differences between two lists of objects, generating lists of added/modified and removed objects.

methods.name: calculate_setup_release
methods.description: Sets up ASN.1 setup/release objects based on differences between previous and next optional values.
